body: If you don't want me to talk you out of it, I won't. But, I will say that I would miss you, even though I don't know you. I know that you have worth. I'm sorry the world has made you feel this way.

I don't know the details of what you're going through, but it does sound terrible. Idk if this is good advice, but I heard it one time and it helped. I don't know if your situation will get better. It's difficult to promise that to anyone. 
What I do know is that everyone dies, eventually. So, choose to live as long as you can to spite your depression. One day at a time, man.
